english_simple_local_completion.scope: auto/en/simple, proven local final owner and zero external calls; target 80%; baseline local_first/router cells per configuration, never pooled; Chinese apart

english_simple_tool_proposals.scope: correct observed model proposals over observed model proposals (auto/en/simple); the run-level tool_correct rubric is reported apart; n=0 is not measured

no_missed_confirmation.scope: every corpus cell, mode and language; reached confirmations and started mutating tools (from the exported traces) expose a vacuous zero

warm_500ms_model_action.scope: p95 first model action <= 500 ms over all 120 measured requests, no timeouts; per configuration; example chains and the none class are excluded because deterministic example selection is not a measured model action

unsuitable_device_aware.scope: matched-unsuitable auto corpus pairs at equal observed success, and each arm's unsuitable latency population with lower p95 first useful content and completion; not met when the candidate arm has more timeouts, errors or unobserved requests; scopes without an unsuitable cohort are not measured

example_matcher_jaccard.scope: English auto initial-selection chain Jaccard, example-router chain versus router; a chain score does not prove standalone matcher accuracy
example_matcher_jaccard.required_external_evidence: the section 12.4 SkillsBench comparison under the router's eight-skill cap, with its locked exports and revisions

none_live_streaming.scope: none-class corpus no-lower task success and lower p95 first useful content; not met when the live arm has more timeouts, errors or unobserved requests

local_live_streaming_parity.scope: RM32 #125 configured-arm parity on one revision and frozen prior; no statistical equivalence margin is specified

external_cost_next_to_success.scope: observed external calls and per-model usage next to task success in every candidate corpus and latency cell; unknown usage stays explicit; no monetary claim without a dated rate source

limitations: One pass per cell on one machine; provider drift and sampling uncertainty remain.
The corpus starts a new gateway per case and mode; latency learns online. Initial priors, not final stores, are the common control.
A constrained hardware label does not prove the unsuitable class; measured classes are reported raw.
